info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Items-v2-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Item Retrieval API provides access to a list of items associated with retail orders in a streamlined manner. This endpoint allows businesses to efficiently retrieve comprehensive details about the items within specific orders, enabling better inventory management and customer service. Ideal for developers working on eCommerce platforms or inventory systems, this API serves users who need to analyze or display item data related to retail orders. Leveraging this API can enhance decision-making processes pertaining to stock levels and order fulfillment.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of items in orders.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all items associated with orders. It will return detailed information about each item, including item ID, quantity, and associated order details.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving items from orders. This payload contains the necessary parameters to filter or specify the items to be returned.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of order items.

ListRetailOrdersItemsRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation related to order items, represented as a string.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the order.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the order.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit related to the order processing.

ListRetailOrdersItemsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operation on orders items, indicating the status and details of the operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the order.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the order was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the order creation was automated.

Audit.description: Information regarding the audit of an order processing operation.

x-processing-time.description: The total time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value can help in assessing the performance of the API endpoint.
